decisions: append_lines gained the keyword `degrade` (True: write unlocked on a lock timeout; False: write nothing, extend's case) and `what` (the noun of the warning), and its `timeout` defaults to None meaning LOCK_TIMEOUT_S read at call time (so a test can patch it): the prereg fixed the name and the (written, warnings) result only.
report_setup sits beside report_layer_seconds in rebuild.py (prereg 2.9); it is the helper the prereg's E-regress diff line names.
A fsync failure after every line was written counts as a dropped event (as at a4ab4a1).
E-stress/E-kill workers are subprocesses released by a go-file after their imports (equivalent to a Barrier after import), not multiprocessing children.
The control tree is a shared clone of this repository checked out at a4ab4a1 in the scratch directory (improve2_probes.py needs a git repository).
